requirements.title: RANDOM_INIT repeatable true gives stable single-image seed
requirements.definition: With REPEATABLE true, the processor-dependent PUT value is stable for the same execution environment and invoking image index.

pending.RANDOM_INIT-repeatable-true-stable-singl: Call RANDOM_INIT(.true.,.false.), harvest a short RANDOM_NUMBER sequence, call RANDOM_INIT(.true.,.false.) again, harvest again, and assert elementwise equality plus all values in [0,1); mutate REPEATABLE to .false. so equality fails.
pending.RANDOM_INIT-repeatable-true-put-latitude: No portable oracle can require the actual PUT vector or exact random sequence because the PUT value is processor dependent.
